caption:
A PD report, written while the borrower is still talking.

A housing-finance PD visit runs about 25 minutes. Writing it up takes a median of 52 more, and 1 in 3 reports comes back to the officer. Real-Time PD changes the order of the work.

Darwix listens to the discussion in Hindi, English or Hinglish, fills the 61-field PD form live, ties every value to the sentence that produced it, keeps conflicting answers side by side for the officer to settle, and hands credit a draft that carries its own evidence.

Credit decisions stay with the credit team.

One shop. Four different monthly sales figures.

In a housing-finance case the LOS says one number, the borrower says another, and the bank, GST and supplier records say a third. Credit ends up reconciling by hand.

Evidence Intelligence reads the PD conversation as evidence, checks every fact against every source, rebuilds income, EMIs and own contribution, and raises only the findings that matter. Every value keeps its source. Every adopted value is chosen by a reviewer and recorded.

Credit decisions stay with the credit team.

A conversation should end in a record, not in someone's memory.

In most BFSI workflows the important part of an interaction is said once, remembered imperfectly and typed up later. Darwix AI works on the interaction itself. It prepares the context, listens, structures what is said, checks it against documents and systems, guides the person in the room, and keeps the audit trail.

Every value keeps its source and its state. Consequential decisions stay with a person.
